title: Application Insights
description: Instrument an ASP.NET Core app with telemetry, custom events, and live metrics.

data.text: Application Insights is an APM service in Azure Monitor. For ASP.NET Core apps, it automatically collects requests, dependencies, exceptions, and performance counters.

data.title: Add Application Insights in Program.cs
data.content: Use the Application Insights SDK with the connection string from configuration.

data.text: Automatic telemetry covers requests and dependencies, but business events and custom metrics need explicit calls.

data.title: Track a custom event and metric
data.content: Use `TelemetryClient` to send business telemetry from anywhere in the app.

data.text: ASP.NET Core logging integrates with Application Insights. `ILogger` messages are automatically enriched with operation IDs and request context.

data.title: Structured logging for better queries
data.content: Use structured message templates so you can filter in Log Analytics.

data.title: Add telemetry to a checkout API
data.description: Instrument an existing API with Application Insights events and metrics.
steps: Create an Application Insights resource in the Azure portal
Add the connection string to Key Vault or App Configuration
Track a custom event when a post is created
Track a metric for database query duration
data.expectedOutcome: Custom events and metrics appear in the Application Insights portal within a few minutes.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Application Insights requires only a connection string to start collecting telemetry
Structured logging makes Application Insights queries more powerful
Use `TelemetryClient` for custom events, metrics, and traces
Live Metrics Stream is useful for debugging production issues
data.takeaway: Application Insights turns an ASP.NET Core app into an observable system with minimal code changes.
